abilities.desc_zh: 显着提高攻击评级并降低敌人的格挡熟练度。
abilities.desc_en: Relic of Fury - Significantly increases Attack Rating and reduces enemy Block Proficiency.

abilities.desc_zh: 提高伤害抗性并限制单次打击对该机器人造成的伤害量。
abilities.desc_en: Relic of Preservation - Increases Damage Resistance and limits the amount of damage that can be done to this Bot in a single blow.

abilities.desc_zh: 立即窃取对手的力量并将其转移给该机器人。
abilities.desc_en: Power Steal - Instantly Steals Power from the opponent and transfers it to this bot.

abilities.desc_zh: 立即窃取对手的生命值并将其转移给该机器人。
abilities.desc_en: Life Steal - Instantly Steals Health from the opponent and transfers it to this bot.

abilities.title_en: Now in possession of powerful Relics, Megatronus does not generate Power as normal, he instead generates {{var_1}} of Max Power every second.
abilities.desc_zh: 现在拥有强大的遗物，威震天不会像平常一样产生能量，而是每秒产生最大能量 {{var_1}}。
abilities.desc_en: Now in possession of powerful Relics, Megatronus does not generate Power as normal, he instead generates {{var_1}} of Max Power every second.

abilities.title_en: Megatronus begins the fight with the Relic of Fury active, each time he gains a Bar of Power he alternates between the Relic of Fury and the Relic of Preservation.
abilities.desc_zh: 威震天在战斗开始时会激活愤怒遗物，每次他获得力量条时，他都会在愤怒遗物和保存遗物之间交替。
abilities.desc_en: Megatronus begins the fight with the Relic of Fury active, each time he gains a Bar of Power he alternates between the Relic of Fury and the Relic of Preservation.

abilities.title_en: The Relic of Fury grants {{var_2}} Attack Rating and reduces the opponent's Block Proficiency by {{var_3}}
abilities.desc_zh: 愤怒遗物赋予 {{var_2}} 攻击评级，并降低对手 {{var_3}} 格挡熟练度
abilities.desc_en: The Relic of Fury grants {{var_2}} Attack Rating and reduces the opponent's Block Proficiency by {{var_3}}

abilities.title_en: The Relic of Preservation grants {{var_4}} Damage Resistance and limits the amount of damage Megatronus can receive in a single blow to {{var_5}} of his Max Health.
abilities.desc_zh: 保存遗物赋予 {{var_4}} 伤害抗性，并限制威震天在其最大生命值 {{var_5}} 的单次打击中所能受到的伤害量。
abilities.desc_en: The Relic of Preservation grants {{var_4}} Damage Resistance and limits the amount of damage Megatronus can receive in a single blow to {{var_5}} of his Max Health.

abilities.title_en: Once per fight, When Megatronus hits {{var_6}} of his health he activates the Matrix of Immortality in addition to his other Relics for {{var_7}}. While the Relic is active Megatronus is Indestructible and immune to all damage.
abilities.desc_zh: 每场战斗一次，当威震天的生命值达到 {{var_6}} 时，他会激活不朽矩阵以及 {{var_7}} 的其他圣物。当圣物激活时，威震天是坚不可摧的并且免疫所有伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Once per fight, When Megatronus hits {{var_6}} of his health he activates the Matrix of Immortality in addition to his other Relics for {{var_7}}. While the Relic is active Megatronus is Indestructible and immune to all damage.

abilities.title_en: {{var_9}} chance to apply Dark Burn, dealing {{var_10}} of Attack as instant Energy damage.
abilities.desc_zh: {{var_9}} 几率施加黑暗燃烧，造成 {{var_10}} 点攻击力作为即时能量伤害。
abilities.desc_en: {{var_9}} chance to apply Dark Burn, dealing {{var_10}} of Attack as instant Energy damage.

abilities.title_zh: 服从遗物 - 服从遗物会削弱敌人的能力，并可能完全阻止他们激活。
abilities.title_en: Relic of Obedience - The Relic of Obedience weakens enemy abilities and may completely prevent them from activating.
abilities.desc_zh:
填充能量条时：

当威震天获得力量条时，他有 {{var_11}} 几率激活服从遗物，防止对手激活 {{var_12}} 的增益或减益。此外，当遗物未激活时，对手激活的增益和减益效果会比 {{var_13}} 弱。
abilities.desc_en:
Relic of Obedience - The Relic of Obedience weakens enemy abilities and may completely prevent them from activating.
When Filling a Power Bar:
When Megatronus gains a Bar of Power, he has a {{var_11}} chance to activate the Relic of Obedience, preventing opponents from activating Buffs or Debuffs for {{var_12}}. Additionally, when the Relic is not active, Buffs and Debuffs the opponent activates are {{var_13}} weaker.
